chapters.d: Your bot combs through Montreal and Toronto market signals, synthesising bilingual updates before your first coffee. Key action items land directly in your team Slack channel.
While you manage client meetings, your coding agent builds a full staging website in its sandboxed cloud computer. Tests run autonomously without drawing power from your laptop.
Your Telegram bot team coordinates research findings, formats client quotes, and writes updates into your central CRM. Every agent shares a single long-term memory buffer.
Even after you shut down your laptop, your cloud computer continues scraping data, balancing accounts, and preparing routines for tomorrow. Your business never sleeps.

faq.q: What are Ceyo's subscription plans in Canada and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every tier includes a 3-day free trial offering up to 1,000,000 tokens per day. A payment card is linked upon registration and is only charged once the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Can Ceyo agents manage bilingual workflows in English and French?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo agents operate fluently across both official Canadian languages. They can read, research, transcribe, and draft documentation in Canadian English and French seamlessly across all tools and phone calls.

faq.q: How does the isolated cloud computer keep working when my devices are off?
faq.a: Each bot operates inside its own dedicated virtual machine in the cloud, completely independent of your phone or computer. Scheduled tasks, browser crawls, and code execution persist 24/7 regardless of your device status or connectivity.

faq.q: How do Telegram groups and multi-bot teams function?
faq.a: You can deploy your bots as individual Telegram contacts or add several specialised bots into a single Telegram group chat. The bots communicate, divide complex projects among themselves, and share document memory to complete complex tasks as a coordinated team.

faq.q: Which software platforms and tools can Canadian businesses connect?
faq.a: Ceyo connects with over 1,000 services including Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, GitHub, and major CRMs. It also features an integrated crypto wallet and full autonomous web browser capability for sites without public APIs.
